cases.note: no .oah/config.toml: every section is its defaults

cases.name: init-template-stages
cases.note: the file `oah init` writes, rendered by init.render_config

cases.name: bom-stages
cases.note: UTF-8 with a byte order mark

cases.name: engines-deep-merge
cases.note: a table and an inline table both merge key by key over the defaults

cases.name: engines-open-tables
cases.note: an empty default table accepts any key

cases.name: unknown-key-codex-permission
cases.note: v0.4.0 has no permission_mode for codex

cases.name: legacy-only-legacy-keys
cases.note: only legacy [stages] keys. Expectation is the effective assignment and notice code of the design's legacy reading table (section 3.1), not a v0.4.0 output.

cases.name: legacy-new-keys-win
cases.note: new keys present: they win and the legacy keys are ignored with a notice. Expectation is the effective assignment and notice code of the design's legacy reading table (section 3.1), not a v0.4.0 output.

cases.name: legacy-engines-read-as-agents
cases.note: [engines.claude] without [agents.claude] is read as [agents.claude]; timeout_min, permission_mode and tools stay in the file unused. Expectation is the effective assignment and notice code of the design's legacy reading table (section 3.1), not a v0.4.0 output.

cases.name: legacy-agents-win
cases.note: both present: [agents.codex] wins. Expectation is the effective assignment and notice code of the design's legacy reading table (section 3.1), not a v0.4.0 output.

deviations.change: 1.0 reports an unknown key inside a table it reads as the notice OAH_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEY and keeps reading; v0.4.0 refuses
as unknown-key-stages; [engines.*] is read as [agents.*] in 1.0

notes: input.json `defaults` is the v0.4.0 default table the command passes for `section`.
`error.message` is the ConfigError message: str(exc) without its leading `<code>: `. It names the file as `.oah/config.toml` (the extractor replaces the temporary path).

Cases with source `design` take `{"read": "legacy-to-1.0"}` and expect the effective 1.0 reading: `stages` (section id -> agent), `agents` (only keys the file gives that 1.0 uses), `unused_kept_in_file` (dotted keys left in the file and not used), `notices` (codes) and `file_unchanged`.

omitted.behaviour: a .oah/config.toml path that exists but cannot be read (for example a folder)
omitted.reason: the operating system's error text is part of the message and differs by system

omitted.behaviour: messages of OAH_CONFIG_INVALID for invalid UTF-8 and invalid TOML
omitted.reason: they quote the TOML parser's own error text; only the code is pinned

omitted.behaviour: Config.raw being read-only and results being isolated copies
omitted.reason: Python object identity, not a file format; 1.0 returns owned values
